=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:380-387,477-480 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Body-marker trust rests on the issue's original author, but any user with edit rights can rewrite the body marker (approved, tracking, checked, ledger), and comment signing does not cover the issue body.
  WHY: Forged marker fields can bind the wrong tracking issue, trip the abandon rule, or inject ledger text into prompts; severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 and glm-5_3-flash said NIT, the others MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:417-422,384-387 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan says the engine replaces `<!--` and `-->` in key-points text but does not specify the replacement, and the Phase 1 step 6 tests do not cover this sanitizer.
  WHY: An implementer could pick a replacement that corrupts markdown or lets a marker back in, and nothing tests it; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet-5_5, glm-5_3-flash) vs MAJOR (gemini, minimax), so the highest is used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:633-636,813 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Phase 1 step 3 and Files & Modules omit the required `prompts/_templates/mode-brainstorm-*.txt` copies and the `Role:`/`Goal:` opening line for each prompt.
  WHY: `test_every_active_mode_prompt_has_a_template` and the template byte-parity test would fail in CI, so the Phase 1 Done criteria cannot be met.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:443-448,470-473,493-512 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan specifies rollback only for a failed dispatch, not for a failed `approved=` marker write after the label swap, and has no rule for an approved session lacking `approved`.
  WHY: The session never passes the tracking filter or the 90-day abandon rule and holds an outcome slot permanently; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet-5_5) vs MAJOR (others), so the highest is used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:477-480 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not define behaviour for an `ai:brainstorm` issue whose body has no valid `ai-brainstorm:v1` marker, or what "reject" means for a bad plain field, and Phase 1 step 6 has no such test.
  WHY: Undefined input can be misclassified as active or crash marker parsing, or stall the topic; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet-5_5, glm-5_3-flash) vs MAJOR (minimax), so the highest is used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:432-435,226-238 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A session issue opened but never labelled (mid-startup crash) counts as active and in-progress, and the plan defines no recovery or `mode=resume` behaviour with zero trusted turn markers.
  WHY: The gate emits `mode=resume` daily and the topic stays blocked until a human intervenes.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:153-154 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The documentation for `BRAINSTORM_ENABLED` is ambiguous about consumer configuration versus the repository's own `internal-brainstorm.yml` smoke tests.
  WHY: It is not clearly stated that the variable must be enabled in the test environment, which risks failures or confusion during onboarding.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:N/A (check-runs lint, static-checks run 44327456700; copilot-pull-request-reviewer run 44292688631) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF` reports `outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed` because the merge ref still uses an old base, and the Copilot reviewer log is empty.
  WHY: This is a stale-base guard needing a base refresh from `main`, not a defect in the plan file.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Add `ai-brainstorm.yml` to `workflow-templates/profiles/full.txt` (Phase 2, Step 7)
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/profiles/full.txt
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff does not include `ai-brainstorm.yml` in workflow-templates/profiles/full.txt. Other reviewers judged this a future implementation step, not a gap.
- requirement: Add the seven labels to `scripts/label_helpers.sh` (_AI_LABEL_COLORS, _AI_LABEL_DESCS) (Phase 2, Step 9)
  expected_change_site: scripts/label_helpers.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No change exists in scripts/label_helpers.sh adding the brainstorm labels. Other reviewers judged this a future implementation step.
- requirement: Each new prompt and script gets its `docs/INVENTORY.md` entry so `tests/inventory_parity.py` passes (Phase 1 Done; Phase 2 Step 10; Phase 3 Step 5)
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No change exists in docs/INVENTORY.md for any phase deliverable. Other reviewers judged this a future implementation step.
- requirement: The parser takes only the first `ai-brainstorm:v1` marker, rejects a plain field failing its pattern, caps decoded `ledger` at 4 KB, and must say what happens when the body has no valid marker
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md — "Persistence on the session issue" and Phase 1 step 6 test list
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The plan never specifies the no-marker case, and the Phase 1 step 6 tests have no missing-marker case.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:"Ledger and outcomes"/"Turn trust" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Marker trust for the issue body rests on the issue's opener; `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET` signs comments, not the body, so body edits can change `approved`, `tracking`, `checked` or `ledger` with no integrity check.
  WHY: A forged value can bind the wrong project or mark an outcome reviewed or abandoned, though write-access collaborators are already trusted.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:"Persistence on the session issue" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The replacement text for `<!--`/`-->` in key points is unspecified and untested.
  WHY: The replacement could corrupt markdown or let a comment opener back in.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:Phase 1 step 3 and Files & Modules | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The plan omits `prompts/_templates/mode-brainstorm-*.txt` (six templates) and the `Role:`/`Goal:` opening line required by `tests/test_assemble_prompt.py:95-99`, line 102 onward, and `tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py:68`.
  WHY: `test_every_active_mode_prompt_has_a_template` fails in CI and the Phase 1 Done criteria cannot be met.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:"Hand-off" step 1 and "Ledger and outcomes" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No rule for a failed `approved=` marker write after the label swap or for an approved session without an `approved` field.
  WHY: The session holds one of the 10 outcome slots permanently.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:"Ledger and outcomes" parser rules and Phase 1 step 6 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No rule or test for an `ai:brainstorm`-labelled issue whose body has no valid marker.
  WHY: Such an issue may be classified wrongly, block a topic, or crash gate marker parsing.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:check-runs `lint`, `static-checks` run 44327456700 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF pr=9239 ... outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed`; the merge ref still uses old base `ab6cdcb8` while `main` is at `fc5f8284`, and `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` failed with an empty log.
  WHY: This is the stale-base guard, not a plan defect; a base refresh clears it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
